card: Cleans up four wallet functional tests by removing unused nodes and an extra node restart. Redundant nodes left over from earlier refactors in wallet_basic.py, wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet.py, and wallet_derivehdkey.py are removed, and a duplicate consecutive restart in wallet_sendall.py is dropped. The changes save roughly 0.2 to 0.4 seconds per test with no loss of test coverage.
changed_since_previous: None; the diff matches the previous description.
evidence: Author description and commit message note that node 3 in `wallet_basic.py` was only used for `resendwallettransactions`, which was removed in commit f5162458cd in 2019.
Author description notes tests run roughly 0.2–0.4 s faster locally without changes to test coverage.
problem: Leftovers from earlier test refactors and RPC removals cause these tests to initialize, synchronize, or restart node instances that perform no assertions, wasting execution time.

risk.why: Touches only functional test setup and teardown routines without modifying production code.

summary: Cleans up four wallet functional tests by removing unused daemon instances and a redundant restart. Specifically, it drops node 3 from `wallet_basic.py` (allowing standard sync calls), reduces node counts from two to one in `wallet_signrawtransactionwithwallet.py` and `wallet_derivehdkey.py`, and eliminates an identical consecutive restart and wallet reload in `wallet_sendall.py`.
